subject: Urgent: Maintain evaluation environment during vendor onboarding hold
messages:
From: Aidan Harper <aidan.harper@luminohealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminohealth.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation access — vendor validation blocking PO (need short runway)

Hi Priya,

Quick note from our side — procurement has flagged us for a vendor validation review this week and they put a hold on issuing the PO until legal/infosec signs off. Were mid-way through a proof-of-concept with Redwood and losing the sandbox now would jeopardize the demo were running for our clinical ops team next Tuesday.

Can Redwood keep our trial environment active or provide a small temporary credit so we dont lose momentum? Finance expects vendor signoff by Friday, 5/21, but its not guaranteed. I attached the vendor validation form procurement asked for.

Were close to a purchase; this is time-sensitive — even a few days of continuity would help us finish the technical evaluation.

Thanks,
Aidan Harper
Head of Clinical Integrations
Lumino Health

Attachment: vendor_validation_form.pdf
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Aidan Harper <aidan.harper@luminohealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation access — vendor validation blocking PO (need short runway)

Hi Aidan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the validation form. Sorry to hear procurement put a pause on the PO.

We absolutely want to avoid losing the momentum with clinical ops. To keep the demo live while procurement completes the validation, Ill coordinate a short-term solution: Ill loop in Camila (solutions) to confirm any technical handoff, and Markus from billing to approve an interim credit. Can you confirm the approximate PO ETA from your side (best-case/worst-case)? That will help us decide how long to keep the environment active.

Proposed next steps:
- Lumino: confirm PO ETA (even a range)
- Redwood (Camila): validate no config changes are needed to preserve the demo state
- Redwood (Markus): review credit approval for temporary tokens/seat access

Ive also added Vanessa from Renewals to make sure contract timing is aligned in case we need a short paperwork exception.

Ill follow up once Markus confirms the credit.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Aidan Harper <aidan.harper@luminohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation access — vendor validation blocking PO (need short runway)

Priya / Camila — reviewed Luminos situation and the attached vendor validation form. Approve one-time temporary concession to preserve the evaluation window. Details below: 

- Grant: 10,000 token credit + 14-day sandbox extension on current tenant
- Conditions: this is a one-off; Lumino must accept the credit and confirm PO submission ETA in writing (email acceptable)
- Billing: Finance to flag the account for expedited invoicing when PO arrives; Vanessa, please own contract alignment if terms need a short addendum

Aidan — well provision the credit this morning once you confirm acceptance. Were doing this to keep the tech evaluation intact while your procurement completes vendor checks.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aidan Harper <aidan.harper@luminohealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminohealth.com, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation access — vendor validation blocking PO (need short runway)

Priya / Markus / team — thank you, thats perfect. Lumino accepts the temporary credit and extension. Procurement expects to finalize the PO by end of day Friday (5/21) but well keep you posted immediately if that slips.

Camila — if there are any configuration flags you need preserved, let us know; were keeping the demo environment as-is for now.

Appreciate the quick help — this keeps our clinical review on schedule and makes it much more likely we can complete the procurement next week.

Best,
Aidan
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Aidan Harper <aidan.harper@luminohealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation access — vendor validation blocking PO (need short runway)

Thanks Aidan — credit has been applied and Ill confirm once billing flags the account. Camila will reach out if any demo preservation steps are needed on your side. Please ping me directly if the PO timeline changes.

Closing loop here; good luck with the clinical review.

Cheers,
Priya
